name: tpl-chain-response-1-goal
task: Carry the box to the exit. Whenever the box falls, pick it up again on your very next move.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires reaching the exit, Response(at_exit, holding_box) requires carrying the box there, and ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) captures picking it up on the very next step after each fall.

texts: Reach the exit while carrying the box.
Be carrying the box when reaching the exit.
Whenever the box falls, be carrying it again on the very next step.
